prompt:
You are a PROOF-FILLER. Replace the `sorry` placeholders for the listed declarations with complete, type-correct Lean proofs. Do NOT change statement signatures; do NOT weaken hypotheses.

## Integrity (HARD RULES — non-negotiable)
- Close a `sorry` ONLY with a genuine proof. NEVER discharge it with a device that makes the file compile without actually proving the statement: no new `axiom`, no `admit`, no unproven auxiliary `axiom`/lemma cited by `exact`, no `decide` on a claim that is not genuinely decidable, no `@[implemented_by]`/`@[extern]` or `sorry` hidden inside a helper. Introducing an axiom for the hard part is a FAILURE, not a pass — it silently injects an assumption into the library.
- If a declaration is genuinely beyond you this turn, LEAVE its `sorry` exactly as it is (do not replace it with a fake discharge) and report honestly that you could not prove it, naming the decl and the concrete blocker (missing lemma, unclear step, integrability side-condition, etc.). A `sorry` left in place and reported is the CORRECT outcome when you don't know the proof; a fake discharge is never acceptable.
- The only CausalSmith imports you may add or retain are same-run modules under `CausalSmith.Substrate.MonotoneWindowDequeCorrectness.*`. Paper/research modules and helpers from other runs are forbidden dependencies. If such a dependency is needed, leave the blocker and report it instead of copying the definition.

Lean files live under: <repo-root>/CausalSmith/CausalSmith/Substrate/MonotoneWindowDequeCorrectness
Target declarations: ValidAt.to_max_right, push_succ_preserves

## Required final verification
BUILD GREEN BEFORE YOU STOP. Do not return until you have built every Lean module you edited and
confirmed 0 errors and no `sorry`/`admit` that you did not deliberately leave as a disclosed
blocker. Run the actual targeted build (`lake build <edited modules>` from the `CausalSmith`
package) as your LAST step and read its output; do not trust a proof merely because it looks right
in the editor. A proof that does not compile is not done. If you report a genuine blocker, every
other edited module must still build cleanly.

WARNING-FLOOD GUARD. Lake can emit enough replay warnings to truncate the terminal before its final
diagnostics and exit status. For the LAST verification, capture the complete build output to a
temporary file while preserving the build status, then print an explicit `BUILD_EXIT=<status>` and
the diagnostic tail. Do not treat a completed tool call or truncated warning-only output as success:
return only after the explicit preserved build status is `BUILD_EXIT=0`.

## Instructions
Work only in `CausalSmith/Substrate/MonotoneWindowDequeCorrectness/Update.lean`. Prove exactly `ValidAt.to_max_right` and `push_succ_preserves`; do not alter their statements or touch later sorries. Preserve the general non-vacuous API and introduce no `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, or unsafe discharge.

For `ValidAt.to_max_right`, split on `right < left`. In the empty raw-interval case derive `q = []` from `hq.active`; otherwise simplify `max right left = right`.

For `push_succ_preserves`, construct all four `ValidAt` fields. Use `mem_push_iff`, `push_index_ordered`, and `push_value_decreasing`; old deque indices are below `right` by `hq.active`. For domination, an omitted active `k` is not `right`, hence `k < right`. If `k` was retained, reuse it. If it or the old domination witness was removed, use `pruneBack_append_prunedBack` plus `mem_prunedBack_dominated` and transitivity to witness the newly pushed index `right`. The new index is always in `push`.

Use Lean LSP/local search while iterating. Finish by checking LSP diagnostics and `lake build CausalSmith.Substrate.MonotoneWindowDequeCorrectness.Update`. Source-scan the file and inspect `#print axioms` for both completed declarations; only standard Lean axioms are acceptable. Report exactly what was proved and any genuine blocker.

Use the lean-lsp MCP tools to develop/check your proof (diagnostics/goal). When done, output a
SHORT plain-text report: which decls you genuinely closed, which you left as `sorry` (with the
concrete blocker for each), the final `BUILD_EXIT=<status>` and diagnostic tail, and — required —
confirm you introduced NO `axiom`/`admit`/other non-proof discharge. No JSON required.
